column3: NKJV has “the twelve apostles,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the apostles.”
NKJV has “I will no longer eat of it,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “I will not eat it.”
NKJV lacks “from now on,” as does the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it.
Close to the Greek; NKJV supplies “He also took.”
